one_line: Pair every ingredient line with the matching hands-on shot, and end on the family moment, not the product.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down shot of a toddler's legs in a bath, a football and a foam boat. Voiceover (transcript) and subtitle: 'כל הערב יש לנו את הרגע הזה שאני הכי אוהבת ביום, האמבטיה'.
q1_hook.why: A moving, real bath scene with voice and text from frame one avoids a slow intro (H1, H6). But it is a mood line, not a problem or a promise: the product and what it gives only appear from about 3 to 10 s (H2).

beats.what: Top-down toddler legs in the bath, toys; subtitle 'האמבטיה'
beats.why: A real, warm moment; no product yet.

beats.what: BOTAO foam-soap bottle on a shelf, hand pumps foam; 'לאחרונה התחלנו להשתמש ב-BOTAO'
beats.why: Brand named at about 3 s, foam shown at once.

beats.what: Hands wash a toddler's hair and back with foam; 'עם רכיבים טבעיים', 'שמתאימים במיוחד לעור רגיש'
beats.why: Claim lines sit over matching hands-on footage.

beats.what: Girl about 3 laughs with foam on her cheeks; 'קמומיל וקלנדולה'
beats.why: The laugh is the emotional peak; it makes 'gentle' feel true.

beats.what: Baby on a blanket hugs the cream bottle; 'אחרי המקלחת אני מורחת להם את קרם הלחות'
beats.why: A charming child shot re-opens interest for the second product.

beats.what: Cream pumped on a baby's leg and rubbed in; 'הוא מכיל שמן אבוקדו', 'שיבולת שועל, שמן חוחובה'
beats.why: Ingredient list over one close-up; the driest stretch.

beats.what: Leg and foot with a visible sheen; 'זה לגמרי הפך להיות אחד הרגעים הכי כיפיים ביום שלנו'
beats.why: Skin result and the personal line arrive together.

beats.what: Toddler hugging an adult, seen from behind; 'ובסוף החיבוק הקטן לפני השינה'
beats.why: Ends on the feeling, not the product.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, no send or save reason in the video or caption. The caption's first line is a shared feeling about bath time, but it asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: The evening routine (bath, lotion, hug) gives a built-in order and a warm payoff (K2, R4). The picture changes every 3 to 11 s (R3). It sags at 0:24 to 0:31, where an ingredient list runs over one close-up (R3, R1). Nothing gives a reason to send it (R5).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. The caption has no ask; its last line is 'בשיתוף @botao_baby', which is a credit, not an action. No link, no code, no keyword.
q3_cta.why: The hug end is a clean finish (E8), but a viewer who now wants the soap or cream has no next step, and nothing is said or shown after the value (C6). No question or send reason either (C4, R6).

q4_shown.what: The BOTAO foam-soap bottle (frog label) at about 3 s, foam used on a toddler's hair and back 0:07 to 0:13; a girl with foam on her cheeks 0:14 to 0:18; the cream bottle 0:18 to 0:24; cream rubbed on a leg. No price.
q4_shown.why: Both products are handled and used, and the brand shows on the bottles twice (H3, K5). The first product is not on screen until about 3 s (S1). A parent's first-person use ('אני מורחת') is a vouch, though the lines read as brand copy (S6). Children's faces show, which LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 7 shots in 38 s, about 5 s each (cuts near 3, 7, 14, 19, 24, 36 s). Straight cuts, each timed to a new voiceover sentence; no speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 2 line chunks. Ends on a hug, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Picture and sentence change together, which keeps the pace even (E2, R3). Subtitles help muted viewers but are near-verbatim and sit low (E4, T2). The 11 s shot at 0:24 to 0:35 is the longest hold (R1). It stops right after the hug (E8).

q6_topic.what: A sponsored evening routine: bath, lotion, cuddle, with a natural baby-care range. Serves parents looking for gentle products for sensitive skin.
q6_topic.why: A daily ritual parents share, framed as the favourite part of the day, feels familiar (K6) and ends warm (K1). The claims ('מתאימים במיוחד לעור רגיש', 'עוזר למנוע יובש') are brand wording, stated flatly and not tied to her own result (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone: top-down on the bath, over the shoulder at the hair wash, a girl's face close up, a baby on a blanket, a tight cream rub-in. A static shelf shot, both hands in frame. A hug seen from behind. Mother's hands only.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down and hands-in-frame shots put the viewer in the parent's seat (F5, S4). Close-ups fill the phone screen and the bottle labels read when held near (F4). Home, handheld and bathroom light read as native, if a little soft (H8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles with a thin dark outline, centred, 1 to 2 lines, at about 72 to 78% of the frame height, from 0:00 to the end, near-verbatim voiceover: 'כל ערב יש לנו את הרגע הזה שאני הכי אוהבת ביום - האמבטיה' (0:00), 'לאחרונה התחלנו להשתמש ב-BOTAO' (0:04), 'ובסוף החיבוק הקטן לפני השינה' (0:35). No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: 'יש משהו בזמן אמבטיה שתמיד מרגיע את כולם 🤍'. About 50 words in short paragraphs: the feeling, the brand intro, then 'בשיתוף @botao_baby' as the last line. No hashtags, no question, no CTA.
q8_text.why: Burned-in subtitles let a muted viewer follow (T1), but they are close to a transcript and sit inside the bottom 35% (T2, T4, F2). The caption opens with a feeling, not search words, and has no hashtags (T7). The partnership word is right but comes after 'more' (T8, S7).

weak_points: A brand-script voiceover and an 11 s ingredient list; subtitles in the bottom band; no CTA or question; the partnership word only at the end of the caption; no personal result said.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the bedtime routine as hands only: book off the shelf, opened, a page turned, a close-up of the name, ending on the closed book.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's; the paid-partnership label (media info says 0); music (none evident); the collaboration terms. Correction: the first product shot starts at about 3.0 s in the frames, not 3.2 s. The last shot is a toddler seen from behind hugging an adult.
